description: Slides from one voltage to another over a set time, starting on a trigger and pulsing when it arrives

params.text: Starts a slide, as a rising edge at the trigger jack does
Sets the slide time, 0 to 1 multiplied by the scale switch beneath it
Multiplies the slide time by 1, 10 or 100
Multiplies the starting voltage after its offset knob has been added, -5 to 5
Adds -5V to 5V to the starting voltage before it is multiplied by its scale knob
Multiplies the target voltage after its offset knob has been added, -5 to 5
Adds -5V to 5V to the target voltage before it is multiplied by its scale knob
Bends the slide away from a straight line, -5 to 5; at 0 the slide is linear, positive settings start slowly and negative settings start quickly
In the Track position the two voltages and the timing keep being read while a slide is running, and a new trigger restarts it; in Hold they are frozen at the moment the slide starts

inputs.text: A rising edge here starts a slide from the first voltage to the second
Sets the slide time in seconds, multiplied by the scale switch, and overrides the duration knob while patched
Bends the slide away from a straight line over -5V to 5V, and overrides the shape knob while patched
The voltage the slide starts from, before the offset and scale knobs beneath it are applied
The voltage the slide ends at, before the offset and scale knobs beneath it are applied

outputs.text: Carries the sliding voltage, and holds the last value it reached between slides
Sends a 1ms pulse when a slide reaches its end; patch it back to the trigger jack to make the slide repeat

notes: with nothing patched to either voltage input the slide runs between the two offset knob settings
the lamp beside the duration controls dims as the slide runs and goes out when it finishes
the maker's README describes Track and Hold as a right-click menu item; in this build it is the switch at the top of the panel and there is no menu

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
